input.content: Thanks, Lucas — you're verified! To help with the cancellations, could you tell me the order IDs for the two orders you'd like to cancel? Just a heads-up: cancellation applies to an entire pending order rather than individual items, so if each order contains only the item you want to cancel, that works perfectly. Also, could you share the reason for each cancellation (either 'no longer needed' or 'ordered by mistake')?
